summary: Proposal 1 is the stronger foundation: its modular adapters, fail-closed geometry, product-specific evidence, correlation-aware confidence, conservative queue ranking, and task-bound monitoring align well with the task. I would adopt it after targeted corrections, but not as written because fetch-time-only evidence can still become a current availability claim, the exit-code contract disagrees with the failure policy, and several monitoring and browser-integration details remain underspecified.

blocking_findings.description: An observation with no native report time can be treated as freshly observed at fetch time and qualify a station as currently available.
blocking_findings.required_change: Represent missing native time as freshness-unknown; bar such evidence from current eligibility when it is the sole positive evidence, or impose an explicit conservative cap and render it only as uncertain.

blocking_findings.description: Exit code 0 is defined as any successful source, while the failure table requires exit code 3 when no availability-capable source succeeds.
blocking_findings.required_change: Define usefulness in terms of at least one successful availability-capable source; discovery-only success must still produce the health-bearing degraded exit.

blocking_findings.description: The design does not specify skipped-tick behavior or the concrete nonblocking mechanism by which Codex consumes NDJSON while remaining responsive to user stop requests.
blocking_findings.required_change: Specify bounded output polling, monotonic deadlines, skipped-cycle reporting, and no catch-up bursts.

non_blocking_findings.description: Requiring three station anchors excludes a useful two-corner rectangle form.
non_blocking_findings.required_change: Support an explicit two-anchor rectangle mode or document why only polygon-defining anchors are accepted.

non_blocking_findings.description: Conflict polarity and strongest-within-correlation-group selection are not mathematically defined.
non_blocking_findings.required_change: Specify status polarity, zero-weight handling, tie-breaking, and whether strength means absolute effective contribution.

non_blocking_findings.description: The BrowserPort contract does not define the actual subprocess or structured-output protocol for agent-browser.
non_blocking_findings.required_change: Document invocation, output validation, cancellation, session handling, and failure classification.

assumptions: The unversioned Yandex fields described in the task remain available only as provisional implementation targets.
Fetch time does not establish the age of an upstream community report.
Monitoring must continue through indefinite recoverable source outages until explicitly stopped.
